title: The Bronze Serpent
anchor_kjv: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
thread: Dying, poisoned people are given a cure that is not what they asked for - not the serpents removed, but a bronze serpent lifted on a pole to look at and live. Jesus later points to that pole and says it was a picture of His own cross.
